resources.string: MQTT pauses the web interface. BLE can switch back to HTTP or open web access for 15 minutes.
The web interface will pause while MQTT is active. You can return to HTTP from this app.

Experimental stock DNS setup for migration. First join Wi-Fi normally and obtain the feeder’s address, subnet mask and gateway from your router. Reserve that address before using it as static. Enter the real Wi-Fi credentials above. Keep this screen connected for several minutes; intermediate connection errors are expected. Interrupted setup may leave temporary credentials: reconnect and use Restore DHCP and Wi-Fi. DNS may revert on reconnect; Wi-Fi success does not verify DNS or OTA.

IPv4 configuration. DHCP obtains the address and DNS automatically. Static IPv4 saves the address, mask, gateway and DNS on the feeder and reconnects Wi-Fi. Reserve the static address on your router to avoid a conflict. BLE remains available if network settings need correcting.
Keep your feeder nearby and powered on. Select it below to configure its connection.
Couldn’t scan for feeders. Check Bluetooth and permissions, then reopen this screen.
Bluetooth and location permissions are needed to find your feeder.
